svg.title: Boiler flow and return temperature between midnight and 3 am, at 69 °C and at 60 °C
svg.desc: Two panels. At 69 °C the return rarely drops below 55 °C. At 60 °C the whole sawtooth sits in the condensing zone, but the burner still starts every few minutes.
svg.text: 69 °C, night of 10–11 Nov: 17 burner starts in 3 hours, 8 °C outside
60 °C, night of 14–15 Nov: 22 burner starts in 3 hours, 3 °C outside
